program.name: Kick Tabata Strength
program.subject: Kickboxing
program.blurb: Kick Tabatas then leg strength, or knee Tabatas then core.
program.about: Kickboxing on the Tabata clock, twenty seconds hard and ten seconds rest. One day is kick Tabatas, then straight sets for the legs; the other is knee and punch Tabatas, then core work for the turn of the hips. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels bring longer combinations and harder moves.
program.split: Kick Tabatas & legs / knee Tabatas & core
